continuity: The white-robed mages can use varied Magic beyond body enhancement and Gravity Magic; Jin’s repeated dispellings make their energy reverse and incapacitate them.
Nineteen of the twenty white-robed mages have fallen. The Grand Mage remains, separated from Jin by a powerful barrier; Jin believes he has only one chance to break through before she escapes.
The Grand Mage is a veiled woman whose name and face Jin does not know. She leads the white-robed mages and has just released a vast amount of energy.
Jin’s Qi Sense improves slightly, and he gains somewhat freer control of qi after dispelling Magic.
plot: Jin Taekyung breaks through the white-robed mages’ varied spells and binding magic, with the System reporting improved Qi Sense and freer control of qi. He reaches the Grand Mage, revealed to be a veiled woman; her barrier makes a single failed strike enough to let her escape. She says she prepared more, then unleashes an enormous surge of energy.
